shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
Traveling can teach you many valuable lessons.
Cooking at home is often healthier than eating out.
Listening to music helps me focus while studying.
Taking a walk in nature is refreshing and calming.
Volunteering can provide a sense of purpose and community.
Learning a new language opens up many opportunities for you.
Maintaining a balanced diet is important for your health.
Exploring different cultures can broaden your perspective on life.
Finding a hobby you love can greatly enhance your daily routine.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of travel on personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to stay motivated to work out?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is regular exercise for overall health?
Q4: What tips would you give someone trying to start an exercise routine?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about artistic hobbies.
questions: Q1: What artistic hobbies do you engage in regularly?
Q2: Have you faced any difficulties while pursuing your art?
Q3: What do you think is the value of engaging in creative activities?
Q4: How would you encourage someone to start exploring their artistic side?
